translation.name: Le'ec Ada' U T'an A Dios A Tumulbene

book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: Le'ec Ada' a Paye' Carta u Tz'iibtaj aj Pablo Ti'ijoo' a Hermano ich Caj Corinto.

content: U tz'iib aj Pablo yoc'ol a janal a tz'abi ti'i a ma' jil Dioso.

Pues te'i. Aleebe bel in quin tz'iibte te'ex yoc'ol a janal a tz'abi ti'i a dios a betabiji. Jaj a t'ane'ex. Tulacalo'on ti weel tz'etz'eec yoc'ol abe'e. C'u' betiqui, mac a top tan u tuclic ti yaab u yeele, walac u tz'eec u bajil jabix yaab u yeele. Ma' qui' a tuclique'ex jabix top yaab a weele'exe. Mas qui' a yacuntique'ex a bajil ta bajile'exe. Walac u yantal u muc' a t'ane'ex tanile'ex a betic ti baalo'.
Le'ec mac a tan u tuclic ti top yaab u yeele, ma'ax to u yeelte c'u' a c'abeet ca' u yeelte.
C'u' betiqui, mac a yaj u yubi a Dioso, eeltzil u men a Dioso.
Pues te'i. Uxtun u jantabül a janal a tz'abi ti'i a dios a betabiji. Jaj a t'ane'ex ti ma' Dios abe'e. Jadi' a Dios ti ca'ana, jadi' a chucul Dioso.
Tu t'anoo' a cristianojo, yan ti yaab a dios jabix c'u'ac taca. Yan ti yaab jabix a noochtzili. Ca'ax yan ti yaab a jabix abe' ti ca'an wa ti lu'um tu t'anoo' a cristianojo,

ti'i ino'ono, jadi' jun tuul ilic a Dios a yana. Le'ec abe'e, le'ec a Tattzili. Le'ec ala'aji, u tz'aj betabül tulacal c'u' a yana. Yano'on jadi' ti'i ca' ti tz'oques ala'aji. Jadi' jun tuul ilic a Noochtzil a yana. Le'ec abe'e, le'ec a Jesucristojo. Le'ec, u betaj tulacal a c'u' a yana. Chen u men ala'aji, tz'abi ti cuxtal jumpul.

Pues te'i. Ca'ax baalo' ti yan, ma' tulacaloo' u yeel abe' yoc'ol a Dioso. Yan a sucoo' to u tucle jabix cuxa'an a dios a betabiji. Le'ec ca' u jantoo' c'u' a tz'abi ti'i a jabix a dios abe'e, walacoo' u tuclic ti le'ec a dios a betabi u yumil a janal abe'e. Le'ec ti tanoo' u jantic abe'e, walac u yajtaloo' u yool u men tanoo' u tuclic ti tanoo' u betic c'u' a ma' u c'ati a Dios ti ca'an ti tanoo' u tz'ocsic u yanil a dios abe' a chen betabiji. Tan u yantal ti'ijoo' ti baalo' chen u men ma' chuculacoo' u na'at.
C'üma'ano'on u men Dios ma' u men a janali. Ma' u men ma' tan ti jantic abe' ti mas c'aso'on etel a Dioso. Ma'ax u men tan ti jantic abe' ti mas qui'o'on etel a Dioso.
C'u' betiqui, cününte'ex a bajil eteloo' a hermano a ma' chuculoo' u na'at. Ma' a cho'ique'exoo' ca' yajacoo' u yool etel a c'u' u paatale'ex a janteje.

Incheche, yaab a weel yoc'ol abe'e. Uchac que'enech pach mesa ichil u c'unajil a dios a betabiji. Wa ca' ilbiquech u men a hermano a ma' chucul u na'ata, uchac u yaaltic ilic u jante a janal abe' a tz'abi ti'i a dios a chen betabiji.
Ti baalo'o, bel u cu cüxte u sip'il a ma' chucul u na'at chen yoc'ol c'u' a weel ti patalech a bete'e. Quimi ilic a Cristo yoc'lal a hermano abe'e.
Le'ec ti tan a cho'icoo' a hermano a ma' chucul u na'at ti baalo'o, tan ilic a cüxtic a sip'il eteloo' u men sip'il ca' a cho'oo'. Tanil a cho'iqui, tan ilic a cüxtic a sip'il etel a Cristojo.
Wa cuchi yan a hermano a bel u ca'a cho'bol chen yoc'ol a janal ti baalo'o, ma' cuchi tin ca' jantic a büc' ti'i ma' in cho'ic a hermano abe'e.
